meta.publication_rule: Descriptions may be published. Headcounts, percentages and operating claims remain placeholders until the named owner validates them with an as-of date.

functions.name: Engineering & Design
functions.description: Calculations, design development, technical submissions, constructability and discipline coordination.

functions.name: BIM & Digital Delivery
functions.description: Federated coordination, clash-led reviews, shop drawings, quantities and structured asset information.

functions.name: Planning & Project Controls
functions.description: Baseline programmes, rolling look-aheads, progress measurement, interfaces, risk and change control.

functions.name: Procurement & Purchase
functions.description: Approved vendors, long-lead planning, technical-commercial alignment, expediting and logistics.

functions.name: Project Management & Site Execution
functions.description: Work-front planning, supervision, resource coordination, installation control and client interfaces.

functions.name: Quality Assurance & Quality Control
functions.description: Inspection and test plans, material traceability, hold points, non-conformance control and records.

functions.name: Health, Safety & Environment
functions.description: Site controls, permits, training, observation, incident prevention and environmental compliance.

functions.name: Testing & Commissioning
functions.description: Pre-commissioning, functional proving, integrated testing, witness records and operator handover.

functions.name: Commercial & Contracts
functions.description: Bid governance, contracts, measurement, change, cost visibility and commercial close-out.

functions.name: People, Finance & Corporate Services
functions.description: Workforce systems, finance, compliance, administration and the support infrastructure behind delivery.

principles.title: Engineers close to the work
principles.body: Design, construction and commissioning teams solve problems together, with senior review available when decisions matter.

principles.title: Ownership over hierarchy
principles.body: Responsibility follows the work package. Decisions, actions and handover records have visible owners.

principles.title: Learn across disciplines
principles.body: Exposure to multiple systems, industries and project stages turns individual experience into institutional capability.

principles.title: Respect on every work front
principles.body: Professional conduct, safe work and dignity apply across offices, sites, partners and every level of the organisation.

principles.title: Evidence before assertion
principles.body: Calculations, inspections, tests and records carry more weight than presentation language.

principles.title: Leave the system operable
principles.body: The job is complete when the operator can understand, run and maintain what was built.

model_layers.title: Core engineering and leadership
model_layers.body: Permanent technical, functional and project leadership owns standards, client accountability and delivery controls.

model_layers.title: Directly supervised project teams
model_layers.body: Project managers, engineers, supervisors and site support are deployed around approved work fronts and programme priorities.

model_layers.title: Qualified specialist capacity
model_layers.body: Approved specialist vendors and trade partners are integrated where a package requires certified, local or surge capability, under Unique Engineers' controls.

continuity_controls: Role-based competency matrix and verified trade skills
Primary and backup supervision for critical work fronts
Staggered rotations and voluntary availability planning
Cross-training and documented handover between shifts
No staffing decision based on religion or another protected characteristic

principles: Human accountability remains with the named engineer or functional owner.
Client-confidential and personal data stays within approved systems and access rules.
AI output is treated as a draft or signal until checked against source evidence.
Adoption is measured by fewer errors, faster decisions or better records—not novelty.

use_cases.title: Technical knowledge retrieval
use_cases.body: Search controlled method statements, standards, lessons learned and approved project records by activity and context.

use_cases.title: Tender and scope intelligence
use_cases.body: Map requirements, exclusions, interfaces and submission obligations for engineering and commercial review.

use_cases.title: Design and coordination review
use_cases.body: Assist engineers in identifying clashes, missing inputs and repeatable checks while calculations and approvals remain human-owned.

use_cases.title: Project-controls signals
use_cases.body: Summarise progress, procurement and risk records to surface decisions that need attention earlier.

use_cases.title: Quality and handover records
use_cases.body: Classify inspection, testing, snag and asset documents so evidence is easier to retrieve and audit.

use_cases.title: Lessons learned
use_cases.body: Turn closed-project observations into reusable, searchable guidance for future teams and work packages.

review_tracks.title: Market position and capability depth
review_tracks.body: Projects, industries, disciplines, method libraries, accreditations and technical differentiation.

review_tracks.title: Customer and project concentration
review_tracks.body: Historic contract record by client, industry, geography, size and repeat engagement.

review_tracks.title: Organisation and management depth
review_tracks.body: Founder leadership, senior functional roles, succession, engineering resources and operating model.

review_tracks.title: Financial profile and order book
review_tracks.body: Audited performance, current order book, working capital, banking lines, net worth and capacity.

review_tracks.title: Quality, HSE and compliance
review_tracks.body: Certifications, registrations, policies, performance metrics, claims and project assurance evidence.

review_tracks.title: Digital and operational scalability
review_tracks.body: Systems, controls, standard methods, knowledge reuse and integration readiness.
